Features

Built around how you actually get paid

Most finance apps budget by month. But you get paid every two weeks. Payday Manager is designed around your real pay cycle.

Core
💵

Payday Budgeting

Allocate every dollar from your paycheck the moment it arrives. See what's left after bills, loans, and savings — before you spend it.

🔁

Recurring Payments

Track subscriptions, bills, and regular expenses. Payday Manager automatically deducts them from each period so there are no surprises.

📅

Payday Forecast

See your financial picture weeks ahead. Know exactly how much you'll have on future paydays, with all obligations already accounted for.

🏦

Loan Tracking

Manage personal loans and installment payments. Track balances, payment schedules, and see your progress toward being debt-free.

🎯

Savings Funds

Create dedicated savings buckets for goals like vacations, emergency fund, or a new device. Watch them grow payday by payday.

📊

Clear Overview

One glance and you know your situation. No complex charts, no overwhelming dashboards — just clear numbers that actually mean something.

How it works

Up and running in minutes

No bank connections. No data sharing. Everything stays on your device.

01

Set your pay schedule

Enter your pay frequency — weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, or monthly — and your next payday date. That's your foundation.

02

Add your obligations

Enter recurring bills, subscriptions, loan payments, and savings targets. Payday Manager maps them to your pay cycle automatically.

03

Know your number

See exactly how much discretionary money you have after every obligation is covered — for this payday and every one ahead.

Stop wondering where your money went.

Download Payday Manager and know where every dollar is going.
